owner_changes_since_1238: workflow_traces groups candidate nodes once by service/trace, then arrayFilter/arrayExists matches client, SDK and wrapper IDs within each trace.

Trace-level HAVING also rejects a trace containing any failed/root HTTP>=400 span, while still requiring a successful root flow/cron/wake. This is not equivalent to proof of the particular non-root entry.
Additional closed SDK event wait_completed for flow HTTP409, hook_received for nudge HTTP404, and nudgeWorkflow hook lookup HTTP404.

service_start/service_coverage/per_code arrays replace repeated observed-hour and source baseline joins. Existing sample weighting, 24-hour warmup, observed-hour zero filling and max(3*median,50) remain visible.

live_matching_requirements.client_and_sdk: Both status2, exact client.parent=SDK.span_id, same route, SDK error_code unknown_error.
live_matching_requirements.wrapper: Only unknown_error hook.resume for matched hooks.getByToken/hook_received parents or workflow.replay.load for matched run_started parent.
live_matching_requirements.current_admission: Successful root plus no failed root anywhere in that trace; this is the compatibility defect to replace, not preserve.

recommended_merge_plan: Retain the owner complete closed-case inventory and service_start/service_coverage/per_code metric tail. Do not roll back to the ad8 historical self-join baseline.

Expand the existing finite candidate scan to include successful non-root wake/cron/flow, workflow invocation/known wrappers and vqs.process; preserve raw parent IDs, original links and canonical workflow/step names.
Keep per-trace groupArray/arrayFilter processing. The grouped finite node array supplies exact local wake/cron ancestry and same-trace delivery/queue proof, replacing trace-wide HAVING admission.

Build a bounded delivery-context relation: each successful flow ID and each successful vqs.process whose exact parent is that flow. Do not consume links on the queue span or search arbitrary ancestors.

Build successful invocation IDs using either the exact local delivery-context parent or one valid invocation link joined by service+trace_id+span_id to that relation. This is the only necessary cross-trace graph join. Group admitted invocation IDs back by their execution trace for per-attempt array membership.

For each matched client/SDK pair, require its own finite wrapper/invocation proof or own exact wake/cron entry proof before adding client/SDK/allowed wrapper IDs. Other success within the trace cannot satisfy it.

Validate the new wait_completed/hook_received/nudge cases against actual installed SDK ancestry before claiming they are preserved. If their graph proof is missing or differs, retain errors rather than reintroducing trace-wide success.

Retain the current per-code weighted metric, observed-hour coverage, zero fill and threshold output. Validate equivalence on the original synthetic fixtures and bounded actual HogQL before a full-window timing read.

complexity.assessment: Moderate SQL-only follow-up; not a two-line patch. No product tracing field or schema change is required by the known parent/link data.
complexity.test_work: Existing 34 semantic fixtures can be reused, plus owner new closed cases. The current SQLite helper executes finite SQL joins but cannot directly execute ClickHouse lambdas; array-stage verification needs an explicit, reviewed dialect adapter or bounded synthetic HogQL execution. Do not replace semantic tests with string-presence assertions.
complexity.performance_limit: Grouping should avoid the previous per-error seven-join graph, but CTE reuse may still inline physical scans. Claim actual cost only after the final bounded/full query executes; no one-scan guarantee is made.

description_candidate.text: Weighted errors >max(3×7d hourly median,50). Excludes closed Workflow 404/409/410 only with own successful wake/cron ancestry or invocation→2xx delivery (direct/one vqs.process parent or unique link). Missing proof stays counted. Weight=1/sample_rate (legacy 0.1); warmup 24 covered hours; zero-fill observed service hours only; no current telemetry→NULL. Spans≠failed requests.
